text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Visiting Palestinian President Yasser Arafat briefed President Ben Ali on the Middle East peace process crisis.
- Italian Industry Minister Pierluigi Bersani told La Presse an economic strategic alliance between Tunisia and Italy was needed.
- Palestinian President Yasser Arafat met with President Ben Ali and called for action by Arab and Moslem states against Jewish settlements in Jerusalem.

- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui chaired the opening session of the Central committee of the RCD (ruling party). Karoui called for transparent elections within the party's structures. Among issues to be discussed was the draft for the next development plan 1997-2001.
- Tunisian Trade Minister Mondher Zenaidi received visiting Algerian Energy and Mining Minister Amar Makhloufi. They discussed ways to reinforce exchanges between the two countries.
